title: SCE transition table (wire schema v1)
description: One line of the NDJSON stream `sce-codegen transition-table <doc.scxml>` writes: one row per node of the design that can carry a requirement (a state, a transition, an executable action, an invoke, a data item, a top-level script), in document order, read from the same walk the requirements report and the manifest classification use, so a `node_path` names the same node in all three. A row of kind `transition` also carries `index` and `targets`: the position of the transition within its state and its target set, one id per token, so a reader does not recover them from `node_path` and the `to` column. With `--header` the stream is led by one `header` record naming the machine and the §synth-6.2.6 `source_hash` of the document set it was read from, the same value a generated file and a sourcemap carry, so a consumer that keeps the export apart from the build can check it against the machine it compiled; the generator commit rides on that record only, because a stamp on every row would change every line of an export that is diffed across commits. The `sce:req` tokens are opaque: nothing here reads their shape. Each line is one instance of this schema. Authoritative producer is sce-build/src/transition_table.rs. The stability status of this surface lives in this header alone — see SCE_WIRE_CONTRACTS.md.

header.description: The optional first line, written only with `--header`.

record.description: Always `header`. A row has no `record` field, which is what tells the two apart.

v.description: The version of this stream's shape.

generator.description: Commit of the generator that wrote the stream, or `unknown` for a build with no git checkout. A version number identifies nothing here: the crate version is frozen pre-1.0.

machine.description: The name of the machine the rows were read from, as the document names it.

source_hash.description: The §synth-6.2.6 digest of the source set of the document, as 64 lowercase hex characters: byte-equal to the `source-hash` a generated file of the same invocation carries and to the `source_hash` of its sourcemap.

row.description: One node that can carry a requirement.

source.description: The `sce:req` tokens the node claims, space-joined and uninterpreted, or `(none)` for a node claiming no requirement.

from.description: The owning state, or `<scxml>` for a node that belongs to the document.

event.description: The `event` attribute of a transition as written (several descriptors are space-separated, `*` is the wildcard), `(eventless)` for a transition with none, or a pseudo-event in parentheses for a node that is not event-driven: `(state)`, `(entry)`, `(exit)`, `(transition)`, `(initial)`, `(history)`, `(invoke)`, `(global script)`, `(data)`.

after.description: The delay an action carries, in the author's spelling, or `-`.

to.description: Where the node goes: the `target` of a transition (several targets are space-separated, and ` type=internal` follows when the type is not the default), the initial child of a state, or `-`.

action.description: What the node does, in the attribute names its author wrote, or `-`.

node_path.description: The path of the node in the model. For a transition it is `states.<id>.transitions[<index>]`.

kind.description: What kind of node the row describes. An action takes the kind of the place it sits in, nested actions included.

index.description: Position of the transition within its state: the `N` of `states.<id>.transitions[N]`, in document order. Present on a `transition` row and on no other.

targets.description: The target set of the transition, one state id per token, as written; a token naming a `<history>` stays that id. Empty for a targetless transition. Present on a `transition` row and on no other.
